Look up trainable dense vectors for exact integer token IDs.

Accepts rank-1 or rank-2 token IDs and produces one Float32 vector per token. The table participates in optimizer updates unless a loaded pretrained matrix is frozen. Padding produces zeros and receives no gradient.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [ML Layers](../categories/ml-layers.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | embedding, lookup, token, vocabulary, pretrained |
| Settings | In its own window (double-click the node) |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Indices** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Exact integer token IDs [sequence] or [batch, sequence]; Float32, Int32, and Int64 ingress are accepted. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Embeddings** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Float32 vectors [sequence, embedding_dim] or [batch, sequence, embedding_dim]. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shape | Vocabulary Size | `num_embeddings` | Integer | `10000` | `2-2147483647` | The run | Number of token rows in the lookup table. Required. |
| Shape | Embedding Dimension | `embedding_dim` | Integer | `256` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Features in each learned token vector. Required. |
| Lookup | Padding Index | `padding_idx` | Integer | `-1` |   | The run | Token row forced to zero and excluded from gradients; -1 disables padding. |
| Lookup | Maximum Norm | `max_norm` | Number | `0` | `0-3.402823e38` | The run | Maximum L2 norm applied before lookup; 0 disables clipping. Advanced. |
| Weights | Freeze Loaded Weights | `freeze` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Do not update a loaded pretrained table. |
| Weights | Pretrained Weights | `weights_file` | File | (empty) |   | The run | Optional whitespace-delimited Float32 matrix with num_embeddings rows and embedding_dim columns. |
| Starter Matrix | Starter Initialization | `init_mode` | Choice | `normal` | `normal`, `uniform`, `one_hot` | The editor only | Starter-matrix mode used only by Build, Save, and Use in the configuration dialog. Advanced. |
| Starter Matrix | Starter Matrix Output | `output_weights_file` | File | (empty) |   | The editor only | Destination used only when the dialog builds a starter matrix. Advanced. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Embedding is a training model layer node; PipelineExecutor embedding-layer execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as a trainable token embedding layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Input is [sequence] or [batch, sequence]. Output appends embedding_dim. A configured padding row produces zeros and receives no gradient.
```

## Tips

- Vocabulary size must match the tokenizer's emitted token-id range.
- Use the configuration dialog to inspect or build a matrix file.
